title: Masjid vs Masjid al-Haram: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Ek namaz ka sawab ek lakh namazon ke barabar kahan milta hai? Aam Masjid aam ibadat gah hai jahan jamaat ka aada sawab milta hai. Jabke Masjid al-Haram Makkah ki muqaddas masjid hai jahan ek namaz 1 lakh namaz ke barabar hai. Aam Masjid mein 27 guna sawab hai, jabke Masjid al-Haram mein 1 lakh guna. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Ek namaz ka sawab ek lakh namazon ke barabar kahan milta hai?
Kya aapko Masjid aur Masjid al-Haram mein farq pata hai?
Masjid aur Masjid al-Haram ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
